items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: But I was playing with a piano player and my mother said

ctx.x: at the time I had something handed down to me. I was going to be a surgeon and I was going to Switzerland. That's the reason when I was about 16 I was going to go to Switzerland. But I was playing with a piano player and my mother said, "Well, if Calvin don't go, you can't go." I was going with Walter Young.
